result: All four callbacks have s32 results; the three refresh wrappers return this dispatcher result recursively, and the last callback returns its input. The dispatcher must preserve the callback result. finish_stage_for_index also consumes its scan-and-dispatch result as an s32. Both corrected dispatchers pass raw/canonical complete-TU identity.
qualification: No invented meaning for the returned word. Existing callback addresses and control flow are preserved.

additional_dispatchers.evidence: The three stage wrappers and return_argument_b produce s32 results; this original dispatcher has the same return flow as its corrected low-image copy.
The three callback bodies return s32. Only the callback result contract changes; callback operands are preserved.
advance_selected_flag_row is defined with an s32 result, returns its index or recursively returns advance_clear_flag_row. The clear-row wrapper must preserve that result.
